summary.value: When you Guard and cover an ally, they gain Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn.

system.description: When you Guard and cover an ally, they gain Resistance to all damage types until the start of your next turn. Alternate: Agile Defender — armourless, shieldless; regain Protect when an attack misses you, if you have used the Protect Skill exactly once since the end of your last turn; when you Protect, +(SL + 1) to both Defenses until the end of this turn. Chosen permanently.
